scope: North office estimated north window grid and upper east solid wall only; not whole-building acceptance.
reviewMethod: All 11 browser images inspected as contact sheet and individually at returned full screenshot size; compared north facade with official aerial context and office detail crop.

checks.finding: Sparse generic windows replaced by dense narrow bays and continuous white piers across the north face; top height and footprint unchanged.
Upper east office wall becomes solid white. Its ground windows and adjoining three-storey laboratory windows remain; image-left east end is not confused with the west end.
West end windows and curved foyer remain. Existing trees partially obscure the lower facade in normal vegetation-on view; no vegetation removed for these additions.
Inset blue roof, dark edge band, hall upper glazing and lower laboratory form remain. Office north facade is partially cropped in this hall-focused view, so it is not the primary office comparison.
Night glazing follows existing lighting. Portrait view retains the main north grid in base representation above the panel; fine near mullions are intentionally absent from base LOD.

limitations: 22 bays and dimensions are photo-constrained estimates, not a surveyed window count.
North ground-floor grid is illustrative; personnel entrance remains unregistered.
Other elevations, office rooftop volumes and low-wing detail remain uncalibrated.
Mobile is a desktop browser viewport simulation, not a physical-phone test.
Historical aerial source does not prove unchanged 2026 appearance.
